instruction: Order one Nintendo Switch Lite on Amazon for home delivery. Save the receipt in the "~/bills/" folder. I keep my receipts well-organized by category in that folder. So make sure the file location and name are as per the existing organization.
notes: Two apps plus supervisor. search_products discovers the product id; add_product_to_cart is called with quantity 1 and clear_cart_first=true so the resulting order contains exactly one item of quantity 1. Home delivery is modeled by a static is-home-address fact that show_addresses resolves to a known id. place_order creates the order (gmail confirmation emails are automatic side effects). show_order yields created_at used in the file name; file_system.show_directory on ~/bills/ (recursive) reveals the category subfolder (amazon) and the file naming convention, and download_order_receipt with download_to_file_path and file_system_access_token writes the receipt text to that path, which satisfies the content check. Tokens are pinned to apps via token-for to prevent cross-app binding. complete_task takes only non-API record parameters (no answer) and is forced last via task-completed.

plan: (amazon-place-order amazon-card home-address amazon-token new-order nintendo-switch-lite quantity-1)
